lines.text: Paul tells the believers to be strong in the Lord's mighty power and put on God's full armor to stand against the devil's schemes.
Paul says their struggle is against flesh and blood, so they must take up God's armor to stand on the day of evil.

wrong_details.wrong: their struggle is against flesh and blood
wrong_details.true: their struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against spiritual forces of evil

lines.text: The armor includes the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit.
Paul asks them to pray in the Spirit for all the saints and for him, an ambassador in chains, to speak fearlessly.
Paul is sending Tychicus to collect a gift for his trial, and he closes with peace, love and grace.

wrong_details.wrong: to collect a gift for his trial
wrong_details.true: to tell them about Paul and encourage their hearts
